notes.title: Hotfix: v1.0.2
notes.content:
[p]A small batch of fixes and improvements were released today.[/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Achievements now will unlock correctly. If you've already passed an achievement milestone, the game will run an internal check and unlock everything you should have unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]UI buttons are now rendering correctly, no matter the resolution.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Balancing[/h3][list][*][p]Gold to Era Points (prestige) rate decreased.[/p][/*][*][p]Era Points (prestige) to DPS (damage) rate decreased.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We appreciate all your reports. [/p][p]

Best regards,[/p][p]Two Pixels [/p]

notes.title: Release Update
notes.content: [p]With the launch fast approaching, we've been playing Timeline Keepers non-stop to find any broken text, bugs, or anything else that might spoil the player's fun.[/p][p][/p][p]Tweeks in the balancing, color improvement, optimization even further and much more. We are officially ready. And this time is for REAL![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Timeline Keepers will launch 05/06/2025 in the afternoon - UTC-3.[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627920/2bb92daa13ca97e684bde9181f56ad58c267ca94.png"][/img][/p]
